stages.name: rnote
build: sed -i -e "/^    dependency('appstream')$/d" -e "/^find_program('cmake', required: true)$/d" -e "/^app_authors = run_command($/,/^).stdout().strip()$/c\\app_authors = import('fs').read('AUTHORS').strip()" meson.build
sed -i -e 's/^        update_desktop_database: true,$/        update_desktop_database: false,/' -e 's/^        update_mime_database: true,$/        update_mime_database: false,/' meson.build
grep -q '^        update_desktop_database: false,$' meson.build && grep -q '^        update_mime_database: false,$' meson.build
sed -i "s/^    'cp',$/    find_program('python3'), '-c', 'import shutil, sys; shutil.copyfile(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])',/" crates/rnote-ui/src/meson.build

export CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_GNU_LINKER="$(rustc --print sysroot)/lib/rustlib/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/bin/self-contained/x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc.exe" && export MINGW_PREFIX="$(pkg-config --variable=prefix glib-2.0)" WINDRES=windres && meson setup out --prefix="$PREFIX" --buildtype=release -Dui=true -Dcli=true && meson install -C out
